# TPC-Havoc Q16_v4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  p_brand,
  p_type,
  p_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    ps.ps_suppkey
  FROM partsupp AS ps, part AS p
  WHERE
    p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
    AND p.p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
    AND NOT p.p_type LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND NOT ps.ps_suppkey IN (
      SELECT
        s_suppkey
      FROM supplier
      WHERE
        s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    NULL AS ps_suppkey
  FROM part AS p
  WHERE
    p.p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
    AND NOT p.p_type LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND NOT EXISTS(
      SELECT
        1
      FROM partsupp AS ps2
      WHERE
        ps2.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
        AND NOT ps2.ps_suppkey IN (
          SELECT
            s_suppkey
          FROM supplier
          WHERE
            s_comment LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
        )
    )
) AS combined_results
WHERE
  NOT ps_suppkey IS NULL
GROUP BY
  p_brand,
  p_type,
  p_size
ORDER BY
  supplier_cnt DESC,
  p_brand,
  p_type,
  p_size
```
